mapper.select: SELECT s.screening_id, s.movie_id, s.cinema_id, c.cinema_name, s.room_id, r.room_name, r.floor, s.screening_date, s.start_time, s.end_time FROM screenings s JOIN rooms r ON r.room_id = s.room_id JOIN cinemas c ON c.cinema_id = s.cinema_id WHERE s.movie_id = #{movieId} ORDER BY s.screening_date, s.start_time
